GET /api/debug.description: Health/debug endpoint returning a JSON message and ISO timestamp.

GET /ads.txt.description: Serves prebuilt advertising disclosure file from the selected static directory.

GET /robots.txt.description: Serves crawler instructions from the selected static directory.

GET /sitemap.xml.description: Serves XML sitemap from the selected static directory.

GET *.description: SPA fallback that sends the selected index.html for non-API routes when static assets are available.

POST /api/playlist/fetch.description: Extracts a Suno playlist ID from a submitted URL or ID and returns simplified playlist track data.

GET /api/playlist/:id.description: Proxies a paginated Suno playlist request to studio-api.prod.suno.com.

GET /api/playlist/:id/all.description: Fetches all pages of a Suno playlist and returns normalized playlist and clip arrays.

GET /api/playlist/user/:username/songs.description: Experimental username lookup that scrapes a Suno profile, attempts API pagination, and can fall back to Puppeteer scrolling.

POST /api/download/playlist.description: Downloads clip audio, optionally embeds cover art into MP3 tags, packages tracks into a ZIP, streams it to the browser, and schedules temp cleanup.

GET /api/download/progress/:sessionId.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint that registers a client in global.downloadTrackers and sends an initial connected event.

GET /api/settings.description: Returns session settings, initializing defaults when none exist.

POST /api/settings.description: Updates session-backed download settings with provided fields.

DELETE /api/settings.description: Resets session settings to default download preferences.

GET /api/download/song (web-version).description: Legacy web-version endpoint for single-song MP3 download with optional cover embedding.
